item: The session-forensics byte room is measured with the real code: three launcher stderr sessions instead of four, counts capped at 999,999, died_into_phase reasons as short codes
summary: WAL measured the RC2 members at 2,521 to 2,713 B against 2,415 B; the pin test summed typed figures and could not fail. launcher_stderr is 281 B per session at worst (not 250) so it now shows the previous session and 2 earlier unclean ends (it was 3); a count above 999,999 reads 999,999; died_into_phase reasons are no peaks, no phase, no phase start, clock moved. tests/test_session_forensics_budget.py builds every member in its worst case with the real code and sums them with WAL's crashing_thread_kind 440: 2,259 B, 156 B unspent; red if any member grows (mutations: 4 rows, no count cap, the long reason, a 200 character share). Losses: the oldest of the earlier ends loses its stderr lines (not its signal, status or trace); a stderr count past a million is not exact; the died_into_phase reason says less.
